stem.en: Six months after ABC Bakery opens, a large bakery opens across the road and sells sweet cakes at very low prices. The friends go back to their business plan. Which change makes the most sense?

text.en: Sell the same cakes below what they cost, until the rival leaves.
Keep the plan exactly as it is, since a plan is written only once.
Bake whole wheat breads and other goods the rival does not sell.
Stop all promotion at once, since the rival is far bigger.

explanation.en: A plan changes when the facts change. Selling below cost only adds to the losses, so the friends offer something their customers want that the rival does not sell.

hints.en: Selling below cost means a loss on every cake. What else could the friends change?
